Character 2 is covered in white foam or dust and looks panicked.

present.name: Character 2

shots.action: Character 2 hides behind a purple wall panel, with only their mouth and eyes visible, looking nervous.
The cluster of missiles is released and falls away, revealing the sky.

present.name: Character 2
present.posture: standing against the wall, covered in white spots

Character 1 grabs Character 2's hand and pulls them up, swinging them around.

present.name: Character 2

shots.action: Character 1 and Character 2 swing together, with Character 2 wrapping their legs and arms around Character 1.
The camera tilts up to reveal a large Rubik's cube balancing on top of a purple pyramid structure.
Character 1 and Character 2 stand on the purple surface, looking up at the sky.

story.paragraph: A person in a black suit hangs upside down among hanging missiles while a person in a white suit stands against a purple wall looking scared. The person in white gets covered in foam and hides behind a wall panel. The missiles fall away, and the person in black reaches out to the person in white, who is now covered in spots. The person in black grabs the person in white and swings them around, eventually wrapping them up together. The camera pans up to show a large Rubik's cube on top of a purple pyramid. Finally, both characters stand on the purple surface looking up at the sky.
story.summary: A person in a black suit rescues a person in a white suit from a dangerous situation with hanging missiles, and they end up standing together on a purple structure under a Rubik's cube.
